/-- Auxiliary definition for the order on `WithBot`. -/
@[mk_iff lt_def_aux]
protected inductive LT : WithBot α → WithBot α → Prop
  | protected bot_lt (b : α) : WithBot.LT ⊥ b
  | protected coe_lt_coe {a b : α} : a < b → WithBot.LT a b
